services.name: Nikola Tesla’s Toolbox: Laser Maze
services.desc: Explore the world of lasers and reflection in this Nikola Tesla’s Toolbox. Bounce a laser through a maze and try to get it to the finish. Join us for a 1-hour workshop featuring STEM lessons aimed at students ages 10+. REGISTRATION REQUIRED (Registration will open on September 1, 2026 @ 10:00 a.m.) Space is limited, please register at PPLD website by clicking here(opens in new tab). Passport Member Benefit - Complimentary Admission! Become a Passport Member Discovery Center Passport Shop cosmic curiosities at the museum store. You’ll find souvenirs, space and science-related gifts, clothing, games, snacks, STEM kits, books and more. Additionally, you can shop the Online Store anytime! All
